title: An ample module has positive Hilbert degree on a proper scheme
statement: Let $k$ be a field, let $X$ be a nonempty proper $k$-scheme of dimension $g$, and let $\mathcal L$ be an ample invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module in the sense of [def-sc-ample]. Then the Hilbert degree $\deg_{\mathcal L}(X)$ of [def-sc-hilbert-degree] is positive.

source.place: Varieties, Lemma Tag 0BEV (label lemma-ample-positive), with Definition 33.45.3 (label definition-intersection-number): the self-intersection $(\mathcal L^g\cdot X)$ is the Hilbert degree
